calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, min(fiscal_week) w1, max(fiscal_week) w2 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3 GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) distinct_rl, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.channel_code) ch, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l2
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(return_date) mn, max(return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(r.reason_code) ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.quantity) u, sum(f.net_amount) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT dd.calendar_date, dd.is_trading_day, f.u fact_units, r.units_sold rpt_units, f.rc, r.receipts, f.n fact_net, r.net_sales_before_returns rpt_net
FROM dim_date dd LEFT JOIN f ON f.d=dd.calendar_date LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=dd.calendar_date AND r.store_id=108
WHERE dd.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (f.u IS DISTINCT FROM r.units_sold OR f.rc IS DISTINCT FROM r.receipts OR f.n IS DISTINCT FROM r.net_sales_before_returns OR NOT dd.is_trading_day)
ORDER BY 1
calls.output_preview:
calendar_date | is_trading_day | fact_units | rpt_units | rc | receipts | fact_net | rpt_net
(0 rows)

calls.statement:
SELECT 108 AS store_id, 'Lahti' AS store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
